quote.text: What maintenance is due on my car right now

promise.text: How to know what maintenance your car is due for

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "due"

lines.text: Work out what is due by miles and by months, whichever comes first, using the intervals in your owner's manual and one recorded date.

body.text: Your owner's manual lists each job by miles, by months, or both.
Many manuals also have a second, shorter schedule for severe driving, such as towing, mostly short trips, heavy dust or extreme heat or cold.

head.text: Write down when each job was last done and the odometer reading at the time.

body.text: A receipt, a sticker on the windshield or a shop's records can supply it.
If you did it yourself, your own note does.
Write the number down beside the date, because the answer is only as good as this reading.

line.text: One ranked view across every vehicle you own, worked out from your intervals and your recorded dates and mileage, never from a guess.
